svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Cut 45 x 120 mm softwood to 420 mm, ends square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: In each end: two 9 mm holes along the length, 52 mm deep, centred in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the 45 mm thickness, 50 and 100 mm up from the lower edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: In the inside face: two 10 mm holes 30 mm deep, 40 mm from the end,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at the same heights. They meet the end holes; the cross dowels

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (barrel nuts) go in here and the bolts screw into them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: butts between two legs, flush with their tops and outside faces,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: held by two M8 x 120 bolts through the leg into the cross dowels.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: an M8 bolt pushed into an end hole shows through the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cross dowel hole; the ends are square to the faces.
